```sql
SELECT "ID", COUNT(*) as abnormal_lab_count
FROM main."Laboratory"
WHERE "GOT" >= 60
  AND "Date" >= DATE '1997-01-01'
  AND "Date" < DATE '1998-01-01'
GROUP BY "ID"
```
